text:
paul (Docs): Hi all — opened a small PR to clarify Dedicated Capacity billing language, add a Ruby SDK example for provisioning, and fix a couple of broken links. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pull/1359

hana (Infra): nice. Which billing line did you change?

paul (Docs): the "burst billing" sentence. Old text said "charged per-request" which is wrong. I changed to: "Burst minutes beyond committed throughput are pro-rated per minute and appear on usage invoices."

diego (SRE): that wording is clearer. Also add a short note that burst billing is separate from committed reservations and may affect committed utilization reports.

paul (Docs): added that note. I also reworded the SLA table: "Uptime SLA: 99.9% (scheduled maintenance excluded)" and clarified the Burst Fallback row.

claire (Product): please include a short customer-facing example for how to estimate burst costs: e.g., "Estimated burst cost = expected burst_minutes * burst_price_per_min" with a link to pricing.

paul (Docs): added the formula and linked to /pricing/dedicated-reserved. jess — I found an old internal link to /pricing/dedicated that 404s; replaced it.

jess (Support): thanks — can you also add a migration checklist item: "Ensure KMS key ARN is accessible by the Redwood service principal and confirm VPC routing"? We get this question a lot.

paul (Docs): added checklist item. I included a Ruby SDK snippet to show provisioning + pinning a model version. hana, can you confirm the client method names?

hana (Infra): Ruby client uses Infra::Client.new.create_pool and attach_model(pool_id:, model_id:, pinned: true). Change param name "provisioning" to "provisioning_config". Also provider expects kms_key_arn in HCL.

paul (Docs): updated snippet. Pasting the Ruby example I added: 

```ruby
require "redwood/infra"
client = Redwood::Infra::Client.new
conf = { "gpu_type" => "a100-80gb", "min_capacity" => 2, "max_capacity" => 8, "burst_config" => { "enabled" => true, "max_burst" => 4 }, "kms_key_arn" => "arn:aws:kms:...:key/abcd" }
pool = client.create_pool(name: "api-dedicated", provisioning_config: conf)
client.attach_model(pool_id: pool.id, model_id: "redwood/gptx:2026-03-01", pinned: true)
puts pool.id
```

paul (Docs): also added a short paragraph on isolation: "Dedicated pools provide tenant-isolated GPU allocation and ephemeral caches; control-plane telemetry is aggregated for operational visibility but tenant audit logs are accessible."

diego (SRE): add a recommended rollback threshold: "If pool health < 60% or GPU error rate > 5% for 4 minutes, failover route to hosted model." Concrete numbers help customers.

paul (Docs): added the rollback bullet with those thresholds. ci-bot: running build.

ci-bot: docs CI passed — https://ci.internal/builds/5074 :white_check_mark:

paul (Docs): thanks everyone, merging now and will notify #customer-success with the migration checklist and Ruby snippet. :rocket:
